stage: Pre-execution sell intent, atomic paper fills and idempotent SQL recovery
runtime_requirement: All bot services remain OFF. Synthetic tests do not authorize a new paper run or live trading.

implemented.intent_boundary: The three primary monitor exit routes journal a unique sell intent before calling the seller, including the original SQL position, quantity, reason, paper entry identity and frozen partial ladder plan. A checked positive response is journaled and converted into a canonical SQL close/partial snapshot before returning to the monitor consumer. Cancellation or an unknown result retains quarantine rather than a fabricated no-fill result
implemented.atomic_paper_fill: Paper sells calculate on a copy. Quantity, cash accounting, costs and a unique exit-fill receipt are persisted together by the atomic strict portfolio writer. A write failure restores the original portfolio mapping and never reports a completed fill. Original entry references are updated only after the durable write succeeds
implemented.serialized_paper_execution: A per-mint async lock spans price/quote awaits and fill persistence, with reference-counted idle cleanup. A repeated matching exit intent returns its original receipt without another quote, fee or sale; contradictory quantities remain errors
implemented.paper_restart: An inactive prepared or received paper sell can be reconstructed from its exact durable exit event and the frozen pre-sell SQL position. An unchanged prepared paper entry with no such event proves an absent paper fill. Conflicting lineage, quantities, receipts, SQL ownership or accounting remain quarantined. Recovery never sends a transaction
implemented.sql_replay: The close outbox uses the sell intent identity and pre-sell quantity. Existing committed events are recognized before applying a position snapshot, so an old partial acknowledgement cannot reopen a later close or rewind a later partial. Address, run and entry lineage are checked. SQLite's timezone-less UTC values are not interpreted as local workstation time
implemented.monotonic_intent_state: The authoritative store validates state transitions even when a caller retains an older attempt object. Prepared SQL snapshots cannot become received-only fills or no-fill results, and archived terminal identities cannot be resurrected by stale writes. Reusing an identical checked SQL snapshot avoids a duplicate fsync
implemented.single_live_submission: Managed and legacy Jupiter errors after entering submission raise an uncertain-outcome error without trying GMGN. Legacy call compatibility is selected before execution instead of resubmitting after an internal TypeError. A GMGN submission exception is also uncertain, not a proven no-fill
implemented.live_boundary: The current live seller provides submission evidence, not observed token quantities or chain finality. Its response cannot satisfy the guarded checked-fill contract without those missing facts, so the intent stays quarantined. No wallet-confirmed fill, financial proceeds or safe retry is invented
implemented.preserved: Exact 0.1 SOL paper buys, safety/route/capital gates, uncapped percentage runner upside, frozen proportional drawdown protection, bounded automatic paper selection and the OFF requirement are unchanged. No model, policy or trading service was activated
